en: Proverbs 7

p.src: 1  My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

en: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
u.src: 1  My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

p.src: 2  Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

en: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
u.src: 2  Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

p.src: 3  Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

en: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
u.src: 3  Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

p.src: 4  Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

en: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
u.src: 4  Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

p.src: 5  that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

en: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
u.src: 5  that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

p.src: 6  For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

en: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
u.src: 6  For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

p.src: 7  I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

en: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
u.src: 7  I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

p.src: 8  passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

en: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
u.src: 8  passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

p.src: 9  in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

en: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
u.src: 9  in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

p.src: 10  Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

en: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
u.src: 10  Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

p.src: 11  She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

en: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
u.src: 11  She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

p.src: 12  Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

en: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
u.src: 12  Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

p.src: 13  So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

en: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
u.src: 13  So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

p.src: 14  “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

en: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
u.src: 14  “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

p.src: 15  Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

en: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
u.src: 15  Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

p.src: 16  I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

en: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
u.src: 16  I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

p.src: 17  I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
u.src: 17  I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

p.src: 18  Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

en: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
u.src: 18  Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

p.src: 19  For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

en: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
u.src: 19  For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

p.src: 20  He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

en: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
u.src: 20  He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

p.src: 21  With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

en: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
u.src: 21  With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

p.src: 22  He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

en: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
u.src: 22  He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

p.src: 23  Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

en: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
u.src: 23  Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

p.src: 24  Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

en: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
u.src: 24  Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

p.src: 25  Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

en: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
u.src: 25  Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

p.src: 26  for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

en: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
u.src: 26  for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

p.src: 27  Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

en: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
u.src: 27  Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

en: 7:27 Sheol is the place of the dead.
